meta.title: Bike Pilot — Cycling Computer for iPhone
meta.description: Bike Pilot turns ride data into clear stories with maps, stats and ready-to-share visuals.

title: Your ride.
Beautifully
explained.
hero.copy: Track every ride, review performance, and turn maps, photos, and ride stats into polished summaries you will want to revisit and share.

benefits.title: Beautiful templates
benefits.copy: Choose a visual style that fits the route, mood, or effort.

benefits.title: Smart insights
benefits.copy: See the climb, pace, and ride highlights at a glance.

benefits.title: Animated stories
benefits.copy: Replay the journey as a lively summary of the day.

benefits.title: Easy sharing
benefits.copy: Export a result that already looks ready to post.

templates.title: Stories with personality
templates.description: Pick a layout that matches the terrain, the effort, or the memory you want to keep.

features.title: Everything you need after the ride
features.description: From live tracking to polished recap cards, Bike Pilot keeps the useful details close and the experience uncluttered.

items.title: Detailed maps
items.description: Review the route, key turns, and elevation profile in one view.

items.title: Live sensors
items.description: Connect heart-rate, speed, cadence, and temperature sensors.

items.title: Trend charts
items.description: Compare pace, climb, altitude, and effort over the ride.

items.title: Photo route match
items.description: Pair photos with the moments and places where they happened.

items.title: GPX in & out
items.description: Import planned tracks and export completed rides when you need them.

items.title: BikePilot PRO
items.description: Unlock extra templates and advanced ride summaries.

cta.title: Keep every ride worth revisiting.
cta.copy: Bike Pilot helps you capture the route, the effort, and the feeling in one polished view.

footer.tagline: Bike Pilot turns ride data into a polished story you can revisit and share.
